extracted.intended_audience: researchers and institutional grant administrators preparing NIH (NIAID) R21 / PHS-398 grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling an NIH/NIAID exploratory (R21) grant application using SF424 (R&R) and PHS-398 components, including required attachments (biosketches, facilities, vertebrate animal statements, select agent compliance, resource sharing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow funding opportunity instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Always follow your funding opportunity's instructions for application format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample may not reflect the latest format or rules; NIAID posts new samples periodically. Use the FOA instructions as authoritative for page limits, attachments, and formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 508 conformance / accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Note on Section 508 conformance and accessibility: We have reformatted these samples to improve accessibility for people with disabilities and users of assistive technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have trouble accessing the content, contact the NIAID Office of Knowledge and Educational Resources. Ensure application materials meet accessibility requirements where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete SF 424 (R&R) face page fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide required SF424 (R&R) fields such as Type of Submission, Date Submitted, Applicant Information (legal name, department, street, city, state, ZIP), Organizational DUNS, Employer Identification (EIN/TIN), Type of Applicant, Type of Application, whether submitted to other agencies, Federal Agency name, CFDA number, Descriptive Title of Applicant's Project, Proposed Project Start and End Dates, Congressional District, PD/PI contact information, Authorized Representative signature and date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All required fields must be completed accurately; Authorized Representative must sign and date. Incorrect or missing SF424 fields can affect application routing and processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project summary/abstract and project narrative attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach Project Summary/Abstract and Project Narrative (Public Health Relevance Statement) as specified (e.g., '1234-Abstract.pdf' and '1235-Relevance statement.pdf').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure abstracts clearly summarize aims and significance; public health relevance statement should be concise and accessible to lay audiences. Use required file naming/attachment mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table of Contents and required application components
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Table of Contents enumerating required components (Performance Sites; Research & Related Other Project Information; Project Summary/Abstract; Public Health Relevance Statement; Facilities & Other Resources; Equipment; Research & Related Senior/Key Person; Biographical Sketches; PHS 398 Specific Cover Page Supplement; PHS 398 Specific Modular Budget; Personnel Justification; PHS 398 Specific Research Plan including Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Bibliography & References Cited, Letters of Support, Resource Sharing Plan; PHS 398 Checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the PHS-398 / SF424 table of contents ordering and include all listed attachments with correct page numbers to facilitate review and compliance checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources description
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the facilities to be used for the conduct of the proposed research. Indicate the performance sites and describe capacities, pertinent capabilities, relative proximity, and extent of availability to the project. Under 'Other' identify support services such as machine shop, electronics shop, and specify the extent to which they will be available to the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use continuation pages if necessary. Describe shared facilities, containment suites (BSL-2/BSL-3), clinical, animal, computing, office space and other relevant support; be specific about equipment availability and access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major Equipment listing
rubrics_metrics.description: List the most important equipment items already available for this project, noting the location and pertinent capabilities of each.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include instrument names, locations (lab or core), and key capabilities (e.g., confocal microscope with 4 lasers, IVIS in vivo imaging system, flow cytometers). This helps reviewers assess feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research plan structure (PHS-398 Specific Research Plan)
rubrics_metrics.description: Organize the Research Plan to include Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research (if applicable), Bibliography & References Cited, Letters of Support, and Resource Sharing Plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to page limits for each section per FOA; present Specific Aims succinctly; Research Strategy should include significance, innovation, and approach with appropriate methods and analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical sketch format and content
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES. Include education/training, personal statement, positions and honors, selected peer-reviewed publications, and research support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education and include postdoctoral training. Personal Statement should relate the individual's expertise to the proposed work. Limit biosketch to four pages; attach as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attach Current & Pending Support and biographical sketches for listed Senior/Key Persons
rubrics_metrics.description: For each listed Senior/Key Person, attach a biographical sketch and Current & Pending Support documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure attachments are complete and match person roles listed on the Senior/Key Person Profile; missing attachments may delay review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Senior/Key Person Profile requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete profiles for PD/PI and all Senior/Key personnel including name, position/title, department, organization name and address, project role, degree type/year, and links to attached biosketch and current & pending support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accurately specify project role (e.g., PD/PI, Co-Investigator, Consultant) and percent effort where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects involvement declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer whether Human Subjects are involved (Yes/No). If YES, indicate whether the project is exempt and list the exemption number; if not exempt, indicate IRB status (Pending/Approved) and provide IRB approval date and Human Subject Assurance Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide required human subjects protections documentation and approvals prior to award; failure to provide required IRB information can prevent funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate animals section and IACUC compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer whether Vertebrate Animals are used (Yes/No). If YES, indicate whether IACUC review is Pending or Approved, provide IACUC Approval Date and Animal Welfare Assurance Number, and include details in the Vertebrate Animals section (veterinary care, humane treatment, monitoring, euthanasia method).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe animal housing, AALAC accreditation, monitoring frequency, humane endpoints (e.g., euthanize animals exhibiting >20% weight loss, inappetance, respiratory distress), and method of euthanasia (e.g., CO2 inhalation per AVMA). Ensure IACUC approvals are in place.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent research compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: If the project involves Select Agents (e.g., Burkholderia pseudomallei), note agent category, facility registration (entity number), and that possession/use is monitored by institutional biosafety officers. For transfer of Select Agents, federal guidelines including USDA import permits and CDC/APHIS Form 2 must be followed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate Select Agent status (category B), include CDC/USDA registration numbers, and document institutional policies and approvals. Compliance with select agent regulations is mandatory and checked pre-award and during performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental impact and historic place questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the project has an actual or potential impact on the environment (Yes/No). If yes, explain and indicate whether an exemption, Environmental Assessment (EA) or Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) has been performed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide explanations and documentation for any environmental impact determinations as required by the agency and NEPA procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project performance site information and congressional district
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide project/performance site primary location including organization name, address, ZIP, country, and Project/Performance Site Congressional District.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If multiple performance sites, list additional locations and attachments as needed. Correct congressional district is required for reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of proprietary/privileged information
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether proprietary/privileged information is included in the application (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If proprietary information is included, follow agency guidance on redaction or justification and provide required documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate involvement of activities outside U.S. or international collaborations
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer whether the project involves activities outside the United States or partnerships with international collaborators (Yes/No). If yes, identify countries and optionally explain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide details on foreign sites, collaborators, and any special compliance (export controls, approvals, permits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and funding fields on SF424
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Estimated Project Funding including Total Federal Funds Requested, Total Non-Federal Funds, Total Federal & Non-Federal Funds, and Estimated Program Income.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure budget figures match modular budget or detailed budget attachments; justify personnel and other costs in Personnel Justification and budget narratives per FOA guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Checklist items (Inventions/Patents, Program Income, Disclosure Permission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete PHS 398 Checklist sections including Inventions and Patents (Yes/No, previously reported?), Program Income anticipated (Yes/No; if yes, provide amounts/sources per budget period), and Disclosure Permission Statement (whether the Government may disclose project title and PI contact info if not awarded).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate answers; inventions/patents questions apply to renewals and may require additional reporting. Program income must be accounted for in budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe resource sharing plans (e.g., 'Once results of the studies have been published, we will be willing to provide... organisms... subject to the approvals of the MTA under which the Thai isolates were obtained').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State conditions under which biological materials, data, or other resources will be shared, mention MTAs, approvals, and any restrictions; follow agency policy on data/material sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch 'Personal Statement' and relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Personal Statement in each biosketch that explains the individual's role, relevant expertise, and justification for involvement in the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Connect prior experience and expertise to the proposed research; highlight recent, relevant work and collaborations that strengthen the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation of preliminary data and justification of feasibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide preliminary data and narrative in the Research Strategy that demonstrate feasibility (e.g., prior work showing B. pseudomallei can cause chronic intestinal infection in mouse models).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use prior publications, pilot data, and described lab/capability resources to support approach and claims of feasibility; reviewers look for evidence that the team can execute the proposed experiments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical analysis and reproducibility statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe statistical methods and reproducibility plans (e.g., 'ps will be compared by non-parametric ANOVA and multiple means comparison tests. All in vivo experiments will be repeated at least once to assure reproducibility.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify statistical tests, sample sizes, replication strategy, and criteria for significance; reproducibility commitments strengthen Approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Veterinary care and humane endpoints for animal studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Detail veterinary care arrangements (housing, Lab Animal Resources oversight, on-call veterinarian), monitoring schedule (e.g., 3 times daily first 7 days, then once or twice daily during chronic phases), humane endpoints, and method of euthanasia.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include specific monitoring frequencies, criteria for euthanasia (weight loss >20%, reluctance to move, inappetance, respiratory distress), and approved euthanasia methods (e.g., CO2 inhalation per AVMA). Demonstrate animal welfare compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent transfer and institutional biosafety oversight
rubrics_metrics.description: For Select Agent work, document that transfers follow federal guidelines (USDA import permits, CDC/APHIS Form 2) and that institutional biosafety officers monitor possession and use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide evidence of institutional registration and responsible biosafety oversight; ensure appropriate approvals and documentation accompany applications involving select agents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role definitions and percent effort for key personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify Role Category for each personnel listed (e.g., PD/PI, Other Professional-Co-Investigator, Consultant) and provide percent effort where required (e.g., 'Dow (P.I.; 15% effort)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify contributions and time commitment; reviewers assess whether personnel effort aligns with proposed responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of institutional resources and core access
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe access to institutional cores and shared equipment (e.g., confocal core, flow cytometry cores, IVIS, cell sorters) and how they will support the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List specific core units, equipment capabilities, and how investigators will access them; identify any costs or service arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of continuation pages when necessary
rubrics_metrics.description: Use continuation pages if necessary for sections such as Facilities & Other Resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure continuation pages follow agency formatting rules and are clearly labeled; do not exceed page limits for required sections unless FOA allows.
